text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q0","value":4,"unit":"friends","kind":"count","span":"4 friends who came to visit him"},{"id":"q1","value":20,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"pressed on the doorbell 20 times"},{"id":"q2","value":0.25,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"1/4 times more than Jerome's first friend"},{"id":"q3","value":10,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"10 times more than the fourth friend"},{"id":"q4","value":60,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"pressed on the doorbell 60 times"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q2","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"one quarter of the first friend's presses"},{"op":"add","args":["q1","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"second friend's presses, 1/4 more than the first"},{"op":"add","args":["q4","q3"],"out":"s3","note":"third friend's presses, 10 more than the fourth"},{"op":"add","args":["q1","s2"],"out":"s4","note":"first plus second friend's presses"},{"op":"add","args":["s4","s3"],"out":"s5","note":"add third friend's presses"},{"op":"add","args":["s5","q4"],"out":"s6","note":"add fourth friend's presses for the total"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"how many times the doorbell rang in total"},"dismissed":[{"value":4,"reason":"count of friends visiting; already reflected individually by the four doorbell-press quantities, not a separate arithmetic input"}]}
